P.S.(Pros) No development effort is required to uninstall additional software.
https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/uninstalling-vrchat-doesnt-uninstall-eac-windows-10-11

There are some misunderstandings.
> Open source.
The asset is *NOT* open source. It's provided under the Standard Unity Asset Store EULA.
> $80 cost.
The asset is "Extension Asset" thus the cost depends on the number of developers. If there are 30 developers, the cost will be $80 x 30 = $2,400.

[Transrate]
The need for it to be the software described is not important, but I agree with the use of an anti-cheat that can be arbitrarily customized by the VRChat admin side.
I do think EAC is an effective short term solution.
However, in the long run, it is unlikely that the EAC side will be able to individually deal with cheats that target only VRChat, and we believe that the introduction of customizable anti-cheat software like the above will be necessary in the future.
Also, EAC requires kernel-level privileges, but even the VRChat administrator does not know the details of the operation, and it is undesirable to grant excessive privileges to a third party for the contents of the action that is being taken.
[Original]
記載のソフトウェアである必要性は重要ではないですが、VRChat管理者サイドが任意にカスタムできるアンチチートを利用する事には賛成します。
EACは短期的には効果のある対応策だと思いますが、
長期的に見た際にVRChatのみを狙ったチートに対し、EAC側が個別対処してくれる可能性は低いと考えており、上記の様な独自にカスタム可能なアンチチートの導入は今後必要になると考えています。
また、EACはカーネルレベルの権限を要求しますが、VRChatの管理者サイドですら細かい動作の詳細はわからず、行おうとしている対処の内容に対して第三者に過剰な権限を付与する形になっている事は望ましく有りません。

If you are going to do it, you should try to use it in conjunction with EAC. (Worst case scenario, so that we can roll back if a failure occurs when installing a new anti-cheat tool)
The combination of anti-cheat tools is practiced by ApexLegends with EAC and Hyperion.

[Translate]
I can agree with you if this is during the beta testing period to test the new anti-cheat tool.
However, I am not in favor of using it with EAC in the official version, because once it is tested to work, We have no concerns about your scenario and it will spoil the advantages of the new anti-cheat tool.
If redundancy is necessary, I think a new tool should be selected instead of EAC that does not spoil the advantages.
[Original]
新しいアンチチートツールを試すベータテスト期間中の事であれば賛成できます。
ただし、動作確認が済めばあなたのシナリオに対する懸念はなく、新しいアンチチートツールの利点を台無しにするので、正式版でのEACとの併用には賛成しません。
もし、冗長化が必要なのであれば、EACではなく、利点を損なわないツールを新たに選定するべきだと思います。

@{5f643d20b679b323d2ce9c0c|full_name}: 正直、一年くらいは同時にガードしながら一個ずつEACの役割を減らしていって、減らした結果セキュリティを破られたらその部分は差し戻しでいいと思います。
リリースしてからしばらく運用して、様子を見るべきだと思います。
Frankly, I think we should reduce the role of the EAC one by one while guarding it at the same time for a year or so, and if security is breached as a result of the reduction, that part should be replaced.
I think we should operate it for a while after release and see how it goes.

Better = Easier to Bypass.
hmm, sounds like a very smart idea.
People just upvote anything that is anti EAC?

@{5f2f057cabac035d05a6e146|full_name}: Yeah Easier to Bypass. But I repeat "this is matter of degree".
In addition, that's a trivial matter compared to that kernel-level software can destroy your PC (even if not, easily causes BSOD).

@{6086e40cf54fe42106f55863|full_name}: It's a very very small fraction of players that has those kind of issues.
EAC has been used in many other games for years without any major issues including the VR game Rec Room.
People just love finding some small issues somewhere so they don't have to admit that they want to use malicious mods.

@{5f2f057cabac035d05a6e146|full_name}: You and your friends are very lucky.
I can't count my friends on both hands who are more or less struggling against EAC.
You ignore the fact that VRC is COMPLETELY made up of UGC. Naturally, this also means that it is unstable.
Other game examples don't make sense.

@{5f2f057cabac035d05a6e146|full_name}: Please do not lump people with legitimate concerns together with those that want to break ToS.
As far as kernel-level being harder to bypass. It does seem that the Proton version of EAC is not kernel level.
I have not verified it myself yet, but I know people have been able to run it inside LXC containers at the very least. Which doesn't mean it can't be kernel level, but that it is unlikely as containers tend to limit what nodes get passed in /dev for instance and other ways that something could interact with certain kernel drivers.
Besides if it is malicious modders you are worried about, they seem to have already bypassed EAC. The information on how to do so is out there, too... It's not really accessible to the skids just yet though.

Whether it is EAC or ACTk, malicious users with certain technical skills will always find a way to bypass it
This is evident from the fact that even Fortnite, which is developed and operated by Epic, the provider of EAC, has cheats
The key question is how long it will take for the EAC to respond once the cheat tools start showing up, and whether they will respond in the first place.
Also, there are parts of VRChat Team that cannot be controlled, and that is that it runs at the kernel level.
the source code of ACTk is open to user, the VRChat Team can control all the behavior of the system.
It is also possible to take immediate action against cheat tools that emerge.
Of course, this is not the best solution, but it is better than the current situation where third-party code is running at the kernel level, which is highly privileged and whose details cannot be verified by the management.

August 11, 2022, it's too late to that VRChat update ToS and privacy policy, but they did it anyway.
  From what I've read in that update, it doesn't seem like what the EAC is doing is needlessly scary.
  Well, that doesn't mean that subject has been outdated.
  Even now, Anti-Cheat Toolkit(ACTk) is better than EAC.

Today, I was again a victim of BSOD at EAC.

I am getting fed up with it and I hope they move from EAC to another anti-cheat.

I mean honestly EAC was never necessary, this is a social platform and a grand majority of all issues presented by exploiters could have all been resolved by improving server-side security. I think it's overkill for a game like this and was a band-aid solution so developers wouldn't have to invest more into securing and improving their game, but it's not like they would change it or rollback at this point. My main gripe with EAC is the additional performance tax on top of an already demanding game, which isn't even competitive at all in nature and relies on performance for a smooth experience. Not to mention the complications it can cause on varying systems.

details:
*I make my position clear, I HATE some mods as world creator.
 As is known, EAC include security risks. It's completely black box, freeware, and furthermore, yet it's kernel level software.
 So much for EAC spookiness, let's get down to business.
 ACTk has been there for a long time. It's published on Unity assets store.
https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/tools/utilities/anti-cheat-toolkit-2021-202695?aid=1011lGBp&pubref=forum&utm_campaign=unity_affiliate&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=partnerize-linkmaker#description
 
Pro: 
 Not kernel level.(No need UAC notification screen. = windows reduces risk)
 Total freedom of adjustment.
 Open source.
 $80 worth of support(*EAC is $0).
Cons:
 Old assets.
 Open source.
 =Easy to bypass.(But this is a matter of degree.)
 $80 cost.
title: Anti-Cheat Toolkit(ACTk) is better than EAC.
